sentences.text:
Mohd. Anis Mansoori And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
on 19 May, 2023
Author: Samit Gopal

Bench: Samit Gopal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 17714 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohd. Anis Mansoori And 5 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashvni Mishra,Sandeep Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.

2. Heard Sri Sandeep Kumar, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri R.K. Gupta, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.
3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Mohd. Anis Mansoori,Aajad Khan, Fatima Begam, Shabnam, Naviuddeen@ Lalla and Rooma Begam with the prayer to quash the summoning order dated 17.12.2022 passed by Civil Judge (J.D.) S.T.C./Judicial Magistrate (Crime Against Women), Etawah in Complaint Case No. 5396 of 2020 (Gulshan Begam vs. Mohd. Anis Manoori and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Mohd. Anis Mansoori And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172774766/
1 D.P. Act, P.S. Saifai, District Etawah and with the further prayer to stay the further proceedings of the said case.
4.

entities.text: Civil Judge (J.D.) S.T.C./Judicial Magistrate (Crime Against Women), Etawah
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Gulshan Begam vs. Mohd. Anis Manoori and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Mohd. Anis Mansoori And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant no.1/Mohd. Anis Mansoori is the husband of the opposite party no.2.
There is no irregularity or illegality in the order dated 17.12.2022 by which he has been summoned.
The application in so far as the applicant no.1/Mohd. Anis Mansoori is concerned stands dismissed.

3. In so far as the other applicants are concerned, after some arguments, learned counsel for the applicants has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicants are ready to surrender before the concerned trial court and seek their bail and that their release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773.
5.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants for not pressing the prayers made in the instant application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicants Aajad Khan, Fatima Begam, Shabnam, Naviuddeen@
Lalla and Rooma Begam appear/surrender before the concerned trial court within two weeks from today and seek bail, their release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
7. With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
